title: 30 · torn_lock · The Torn Lock
lines: Shiva once pulled a single hair from his head,
and threw it at the ground.
What stood up ended a kingdom in one night.
Insulted in her father's hall. Walking into his fire.
the one who never moves, moved.
He reached up, tore out one lock of hair, and dashed it on the rock.
A thousand arms. Fire for eyes.
They fell on Daksha's hall like a storm.
The sacred fire was put out. The gods fled through the windows.
One sage had warned them all.
A sacrifice without Shiva is a body without breath.
"A sacrifice without Shiva is a body without breath."
And the proud king who started it
lost the head he had held so high.
Do not mistake the quiet one's patience for weakness. That is sadhana.
